title: Analysis of the Frequency and Impacts of Flooding in Chad
organization: World Bank Sahel Adaptive Social Protection Program Technical Paper Series; Pierre E. Biscaye (external contributor)
temporal_coverage: Flood incidence analysis over approximately 2012–2024 and modeled present-day exposure under 2020 conditions
methodology: External technical study compares flood-hazard models, survey reports and satellite-detected floods, then maps population exposure using administrative and population datasets.
limitations: Modeled exposure is not observed damage; estimates vary by flood model and population data. Some satellite years are missing and built-up areas can be harder to detect.

title: Chad Economic Update: Improving Resilience to Floods
temporal_coverage: Disaster-risk context and observed events through 2022, with climate-impact projections to 2050 and end-century
methodology: Economic update combining flood-risk context, service data and climate-impact modeling summarized from the Sahel CCDR.
limitations: The report relies partly on cited data; conflict and displacement statements do not evaluate specific flood events causally.
